metadata.title: Hypervelocity Stars: Predicting the Spectrum of Ejection Velocities

notes: No eligible individual stars are supplied. This is a population-synthesis paper: known HVSs are referred to only collectively or by descriptive attributes without supported catalog names/identifiers (T:p2-b4, T:p12-b1, T:p12-b3, T:p26-b0). The lower-velocity B stars are described only as plausibly ejected and are not explicitly established as Galactic unbound (T:p12-b1, T:p13-b1, T:p26-b0). Entries in Tables 1–3 and Figures 1–5 are simulated populations/parameters, not identifiable stars.
